name: Pashur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Pashur the priest, chief governor in the house of the Most High, hears Jeremiah prophesy, smites him, and puts him in the stocks in the high gate of Benjamin.

note.label: Jeremiah 20: The Prophet's Fire Shut Up in His Bones

points: All Judah, all the strength and treasures of the city, and Pashur's whole household will be carried captive to Babylon, and Pashur will die there and be buried there with all the friends to whom he prophesied lies.

note.label: Jeremiah 20: The Prophet's Fire Shut Up in His Bones
